news.title: Arrest made in arson attempt on ICE building in Atlanta, federal authorities say
news.summary: Inique Hinton, 31 of Douglasville, is facing federal charges in this case.

news.title: Suspect denied bond, judge finds probable cause to continue case forward in killing of woman found dismembered in Smyrna
news.summary: Kingston Bradley, 18, is charged with the murder of 26-year-old Shanteria “KT” Mosley.

news.title: Search continues for wanted man after Clayton County officer dragged by car during traffic stop: police
news.summary: Clayton County Police is asking the public to help them find Christopher Harold Lovett.

news.title: DHS officer indicted after allegedly shooting Decatur neighbor following noise argument, DA says
news.summary: Quadrus Wilson, 49, faces multiple charges including aggravated assault and false imprisonment after the July incident in DeKalb County.

news.title: Smyrna murder suspect denied bond in dismemberment case
news.summary: A Cobb County judge denied bond Friday for an 18-year-old man accused of dismembering a woman inside a Smyrna apartment in September.

news.title: Man found shot at Atlanta MARTA station
news.summary: A man was shot at the Georgia State MARTA Station Friday night, Atlanta police said.

news.title: Felon gets 7 years after gun found during rape arrest, prosecutors say
news.summary: A Hiram man with a violent criminal past has been sentenced to seven years in federal prison after deputies found a gun on him while arresting him for rape, federal prosecutors announced Friday.

news.title: Suspect in 2024 GA 400 road rage shooting arrested in New York City
news.summary: A suspect wanted in connection with a 2024 road rage shooting that left a driver wounded on Georgia 400 has been tracked down and arrested in New York City, authorities said.

news.title: 31-year-old man arrested in Molotov attack on Atlanta ICE building
news.summary: A 31-year-old man faces federal arson charges after hurling a Molotov cocktail at an immigration headquarters building in Downtown Atlanta, federal authorities announced at a news conference on Friday

news.title: FBI arrests man in ICE office firebombing attempt
news.summary: During an FBI news conference Friday night, authorities announced an arrest in the firebombing attempt against the ICE field office in Atlanta earlier this week.

news.title: 1 injured in shooting near Georgia State MARTA station, police say
news.summary: Atlanta police are investigating after a person was shot Friday evening near the Georgia State MARTA Station.

news.title: Suspect identified after Clayton County officer dragged during stop
news.summary: Authorities have identified the driver accused of dragging a Clayton County police officer during a traffic stop on Wednesday as 59-year-old Christopher Harold Lovett.

news.title: Fani Willis claims she was targeted by fraudulent voter registration in New York
news.summary: Fulton County DA Fani Willis reports she was targeted by a fraudulent voter registration filed in her name in New York.

news.title: Roswell man shot by police after threatening to shoot people, authorities say
news.summary: Woodstock police shot a man in a retention pond after he threatened to shoot others. The suspect is in stable condition.

news.title: Homicide suspect taken into custody after hours-long SWAT standoff in Johns Creek, police say
news.summary: Xavier Bryant, 26, was wanted in connection to a Sept. 4 deadly shooting on Peachtree Road NE.
